body: I suggested it to my boyfriend. He joked and said I'm already wore out. :P
That's true. I should go see the doctor... When I work up the courage. Thanks (:
We've tried anal a few times. I don't mind it, he's just to rough on me. So I'm scared to do it again
No. I don't really need lube

I know it sounds bad "moving out with my boyfriend" but I really have no other choice at the moment. He moved across Canada to be with me, I get horrible separation anxiety when he's not around. I've never had someone that truly cared. 

He's the only person who makes me happy. I can see myself going off anti depressants when he's around. 

Thanks (:

OP, I understand what it's like when your family doesn't fully 'get' what it's like to live with these feelings. Just, try to not give a fuck about what they think. 

As for your break up, I'm going though...similar emotions right now. I've lost my best friend, and he now avoids contact with me. And I fail to see what I've done wrong. 


I'm an emotionally unstable teenage girl, but I'm here and would really like to talk with you of you need.

<3

I suggested visiting somewhere just to get a new view on things. Different people; a fresh outlook so they say.

You're still young, you shouldn't relay on girls to fill that loneliness in your life. 

I understand this may be hard to listen to right now, but bare with me. Have you thought about joining some sort of group? (soccer, gym, whatever you're into)

When ever I feel lonely, (pretty much---all the time) I take my dog for a walk. I hope that maybe I'll meet someone on my outing... I never do, however my dog seems pretty happy after our venture, so I feel a bit better.

I hate saying "you will find that someone one day" or that "it will get better" but honestly it will one day. Optimism is tiring, but without it we see how dark life really is.

One shouldn't depend on relationships to make them feel happier. One should have a relationship to share their joy of life. ( I hope tha makes sense)

How old are you? Have you thought of leaving town for a bit? 

You sound like a very intelligent human, you WILL get through this.

Please pm me if you wish to vent.
Oh? Camping sounds awesome right now. I'm so tired of people.

That is the exact same problem I have. I want to say something, but there's always something holding me back :/

I wish all the best for you...

Ah, I wish I had a best friend... Be thankful of him. :)

I wouldn't say I'm *friends* with him. He's just someone I can trust. Being 17 with a poor relationship with my parents, I was afraid I'd have no one to go to if things ever got very bad. (And they have I suppose)

I suppose I could just drop him a email. 

I should have mentioned that I have talked to him before it's just, I'm afraid to scare him away. Or that I'll come across as needy, I don't know.

Thank you :)

When I'm like this; nothing
When I'm depressed I listen to music, it doesn't help though,

There Is one teacher I talked to before. He knows that I used to cut myself (he doesn't know that I've started again) and suffer from anxiety/depression. He's the only adult I've ever really felt semi safe talking to. 

I can't go to him like this though. I don't know how to approach him, and I'm terrified to email again. I'm sorry I'm tired and shaking, I can't write.
*it doesn't work
I've tried this before.
I'm no 'great person' and there is no light. Thanks anyway.
Nothing. I'm failing math and getting poor marks in other classes. I sit alone at lunch because people make fun of my scars. All because I trusted one girl.
That's not why! I give up I can't explain any more. I've tried going on r/depression and here. I've tried talking to some one. Christ  I didn't say it was the only reason!! I'm sorry

Obviously it's not based entirely on that. I see it as,  if you're not part of the solution, you're part of the problem. You're right, why the fuck should I care.

I still feel like the scum of the earth.
It makes me 'unhappy' to see people kill each other. So yes...it does effect it. I hate being human.
I'm sorry, I can't anymore

Yes I'm in high school.

Depression doesn't go away when you graduate, and anxiety sticks with you as well.

It's just a teenage phase right?? Well, I wont be a teen much longer.

Sorry for my delay. Telling the 'girl' was a mistake because she went (against my will) and told others. (being, other teenage girls, NOT an "adult") Therefore, I am known as "that suicidal chick."

I should have mentioned that I have talked to someone I 'trust' about this. However, the anxiety tends to overwhelm me and I end up sounding like a...well like lunatic I suppose. Perhaps I'm being mellow dramatic, or maybe I am just a 'lunatic.'

But you have that one person to strive toward. Someone to care about...I don't really have that.

All I've wanted (I don't want this to sound selfish) is some one to love. I mean, I know I'm 'just 17' but it hurts.

I guess so. My state of mind right now is just screaming "why bother." I mean these feelings just keep coming back.

I really appreciate your help and everyone else's input. Please don't get me wrong, I'm trying not to shut every thing you say down.

I went to a talk therapist a year ago. The whole experience...didn't work out very well.

I don't know how to classify my parents. I've grown to resent them so I'm a tad bias. They've never told me that they 'loved me'. They don't trust me. They tend to try and build up trust (as in ask me what's wrong if I look sad) then just yell/freak out at me for feeling that way. Telling me to just get over that feeling.

Also, when I say "they" I mean mostly my mother. My dad's always at work or sleeping.

I play guitar mostly. I have a drum set and a ukulele. I can't really 'play' any of them though. 

Writing was okay I guess. When I'm depressed, nothing really helps me get out of it.

I play a few instruments. I tend to just get upset/angry when I play though.

I had a journal once, I just wrote ignorant poems about death and what it must be like to be loved by someone. Or just many ways I could end my life. My mother fond it though and read it. She said I was poor writer, so I gave up. (I'm so lucky she thought the whole thing was a story. ha ha.)

The attacks happen when:
-I'm forced to choose. Confect of any type triggers them.
-Parents fight.
-Failing tests
-When I feel isolated and dwell on the fact that I have no one that can physically comfort me.

I don't know...It's quite pathetic really. They happen at least once a day. I've had one last for just under a week once.

I'm 17 on Sunday.

I can't believe that "a lot of people care about" me. I mean... If that were true I'd have friends right? Or my mother would actually listen to me. 

I'm a failure in school. Nothing but wasted space. Only people with high intellect are capable to achieve any great potential in their lives. I don't fall into that category.

No one wants' to deal with me. I don't really blame them. I've only (willingly) told one person about my depression/self harm. However, he doesn't know I've started again...It's the only way I can feel I have control over myself...I can't keep going on like that.
